name: ObjectivesComponentReplicatedState
summary: The payload carried by state fragment type index 3857 (key 22) in the local-player record: a two-level presence mask over the registered objectives-state members, then the members it selects. PROVEN LAYOUT, NOT PROVEN MEANINGS. The identity is resolved: the dispatcher `FUN_146af38c0` reads the type index, maps it to the AZ id `036365f4-a485-439d-8a3f-c51dff6123b4` through the registry (`FUN_1461ae2a0`, `FUN_1461ae3f0`), takes the descriptor's `+0x48` facet and calls its `+8` slot, which is `0x1439eb9a0` -- the only code that constructs the class at vtable `0x148259b90` (ctor `0x143a1f0b0`). The dispatcher therefore calls THAT class's `+0x88` writer (0x141728b30) and `+0x90` reader (0x1417b5080). The real 1736-byte body parses field by field under those readers and re-encodes byte-exactly. The body is NOT a flat field list: the first mask byte selects GROUPS, and within a present group a second mask selects its members, so the card declares the two-level mask and only the members it models. The generated codec in `server/crates/everfall-wire/src/generated/mod.rs` replaces the hand-written module this card used to need.
purpose: Carry the player's objective state to the client: the tracked, completed and active sets, per-task state, the POI entity ids and dynamic POI indices the journal and compass read, and the grace-period end time. It is the replicated-state delta through which the server, not a reply message, expresses authority over the Objectives family. The one measured body carries `activeObjectives` (17 elements) and `taskStates` (43 elements) and says nothing about the tracked or completed sets, whose mask bits are clear.
envelope: Fragment framing only, owned by the bundle/record layer, never a field: the fragment is [varint key][varint type_index][payload] with NO length field, so the payload length is implied by this type. Measured instance: key `16` (22), type varint `91 3c` = 3857 under the 6-bit-continuation prefix-varint scheme, then 1736 payload bytes. Below that, the payload is the two-level presence mask declared by this card's `presence` block: [group mask u8][for each present group: member mask u8][for each present member: that member's body, ascending by member index].

fields.name: activeObjectives
fields.note: Group 1 member 3, named by the ctor's reflection string at 0x14825ac98; the member object at ctor offset 0x1e8 carries vtable 0x148259a50 and its reader is vtable +0x30 = 0x143a69a10. Body: prefix-varint delta count (0 in the measured body), the delta-count-zero branch (presence byte 0x01 with prefix-varint 7), then a prefix-varint snapshot count (17) and 17 elements of 56 bytes. The body is codec.objectives-active-objectives and the element is codec.objectives-active-objective, so no layout is copied into this card.

fields.name: taskStates
fields.note: Group 1 member 4, named by the reflection string at 0x14825acb0; the member object at ctor offset 0x22f carries vtable 0x148259af0 and its reader is vtable +0x30 = 0x143a69710. Body: prefix-varint delta count (0), the same delta-count-zero branch through FUN_143a69fe0 (presence byte 0x01 with prefix-varint 7), then a prefix-varint snapshot count (43) and 43 elements of 18 bytes.

evidence.ref: The body parses and re-encodes byte-exactly: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-3857.hex holds the 1736 payload bytes, reproduced independently from five committed bundles of research/fixtures/wire/wire-fixtures.json (0x73_T0x8_R.bin at 5401, 0x98/0x9a/0x9c/0x9e_T0x8_R.bin at 5402), each preceded by the header `16 91 3c`. Also research/derived/state-bundle-fragments.json fragment index 7 of record 1. Tests: server/crates/everfall-wire/tests/objectives_state.rs (generated module) and reverse/tools/tests/test_ontology_gen.py.

IDENTITY (build 30fe6461): dispatcher FUN_146af38c0 -> FUN_1461ae3f0/FUN_1461ae2a0 (varint type index -> 16-byte AZ id via the flat table at registry+0x40, else inline) -> FUN_146166220 (hash map, node key at +0x10/+0x18, value at +0x20) -> descriptor. func_0x0001406d9970 is `mov rax,[rcx+0x48]` (the facet), func_0x0001406d9950 is `lea rax,[rcx+0x28]` (the name). The facet for this id is created in the type's own record function FUN_143a39e80, which parses the GUID text at 0x148253300 and stores a facet whose vptr is 0x1482531b8 -- an address referenced exactly once in the image, from 0x143a3a007 inside that same function. Facet slot +8 = 0x1439eb9a0 allocates 0x1880 bytes and calls ctor FUN_143a1f0b0, i.e. it builds the candidate class. So the +0x88/+0x90 the dispatcher calls are the candidate class's own, at vtable 0x148259b90: +0x88 = 0x141728b30 writer, +0x90 = 0x1417b5080 reader. The candidate class IS type 3857.

READERS: 0x1417b5080 reads a mask byte per chunk of eight groups over the (obj+0x18 - obj+0x10)/800 group descriptors and calls 0x1417b5330 per set bit; 0x1417b5330 reads a 7-bit mask byte per chunk of in-group entries, 0x80 meaning a further byte, then calls the member's vtable +0x30; 0x143a69a10/0x143a69710 read the member's prefix-varint count, its zero branch (presence byte via 0x1461adf60, which rejects any byte above 1, then an optional prefix-varint) and a prefix-varint snapshot count; 0x145cea3e0/0x145b520f0/0x145b55b70 and 0x143adec40 fix the element field order and widths. Varints are the prefix form of 0x14087b760/0x14087b910; u64/u32/u16 are big-endian via 0x14087af30/0x14087a3c0/0x14087a360.

REFUTED NEGATIVE: the earlier reading took the first mask byte as a selector over the eight members, so 0x02 chose trackedObjectives and its reader then met 0x18 as a count of 24 and 0x4c as a presence byte, which 0x1461adf60 rejects. With the two-level mask the body closes: [0x02 groups][0x18 entries][active: 00 01 07 11 + 17x56][taskStates: 00 01 07 2b + 43x18] = 1+1+1+3+1+952+1+3+1+774 = 1736, zero bytes left.
